name: Houjou Ikumi
source: Ikumi is Yuuri’s best friend, and someone that Kairi’s had a crush on for some time. She’s a rich ojousama who seems all proper and shit but in reality she’s a dirty hentai, who steals Kairi’s photos and peeks at him while he’s showering.
